conferenceCategories: Copenhagen, Denmark Engineering & Computer Science (General) 16th International Conference on Computer Science, Engineering and Applications (ICCSEA 2026)September 19 ~ 20, 2026, Copenhagen, Denmarkhttps://iccsea2026.org/Scope16th International Conference on Computer Science, Engineering and Applications (ICCSEA 2026) will provide an excellent international forum for sharing knowledge and results in theory, methodology and applications of Computer Science and Information Technology. The Conference looks for significant contributions to all major fields of the Computer Science and Information Technology in theoretical and practical aspects. The aim of the conference is to provide a platform to the researchers and practitioners from both academia as well as industry to meet and share cutting-edge development in the field.Authors are conferenceCategories: Copenhagen, Denmark Engineering & Computer Science (General) 7th International Conference on IoT, Blockchain & Cloud Computing (IBCOM 2026)September 19 ~ 20, 2026, Copenhagen, Denmarkhttp://scai2026.org/ibcom/indexScopeThe 7th International Conference on IoT, Blockchain & Cloud Computing (IBCOM 2026) provides a premier international forum for researchers, practitioners, and industry experts to share their latest findings in the theory, methodology, and applications of Internet of Things (IoT), Blockchain technologies, and Cloud Computing systems. As these three domains continue to converge and evolve, they form the foundation of next generation distributed platforms that power smart environments, digital economies, and large scale intelligent infrastructures.The conference welcomes original research articles, case studies, industrial experiences, and comprehensive survey papers that highlight significant progress, novel insights, and impactful applications.Authors are invited to submit manuscripts that illustrate cutting edge results, real world implementations, experimental evaluations, and visionary concepts in any of the conference’s core areas. Submissions may address, but are not limited to, the topics listed.Topics of interest Next generation IoT architectures IoT networking with 5G/6G, NTN and TSN AI generated IoT protocols and autonomous network optimization Edge–fog–cloud continuum and distributed intelligence Zero trust IoT security and privacy AI powered IoT analytics, sensing and automation IoT digital forensics, threat detection and incident response IoT safety, trust and human centric security Digital twins for IoT and cyber physical systems Federated learning for IoT, edge and mobile devices IoT for autonomous vehicles, drones and robotics Industrial IoT, smart manufacturing and CPS Blockchain foundations, protocols and consensus mechanisms Blockchain scalability: sharding, rollups and Layer 2 systems Blockchain interoperability and cross chain communication Web3, decentralized identity (DID) and trust frameworks Smart contracts, formal verification and secure execution Blockchain attacks, adversarial modeling and defense strategies Blockchain based AI model provenance and integrity Decentralized storage (IPFS, Filecoin) and Web3 data layers Blockchain for supply chain, logistics and industrial IoT Post quantum cryptography for IoT, blockchain and cloud Cloud native architectures, microservices and container ecosystems Cloud native security for Kubernetes, service mesh and multi cluster systems Serverless computing and function orchestration Confidential computing and trusted execution environments Zero trust cloud security and multi tenant isolation Cloud observability, telemetry and distributed tracing Distributed storage, object stores and cloud data lakes Big data processing in cloud–IoT ecosystems AI driven cloud management, orchestration and automation Cloud FinOps, cost optimization and cloud economics Cloud–edge–AI co design for ultra low latency applications Energy efficient IoT, green blockchain and carbon aware cloud Integrated IoT–Blockchain–Cloud applications Secure data sharing and interoperability across IoT–Blockchain–Cloud Open source cloud ecosystems and open standardsPaper SubmissionAuthors are invited to submit papers through the conference Submission System by September 11, 2026 (Final Call). Submissions must be original and should not have been published previously or be under consideration for publication while being evaluated for this conference. The proceedings of the conference will be published by Computer Science Conference Proceedings in Computer Science & Information Technology (CS & IT) series (Confirmed).Selected papers from IBCOM 2026, after further revisions, will be published in the special issue of the following journals.
